ns2:course.label: Synoptic Meteorology
ns2:course.description: Examines the observed behavior of the atmosphere through the application of physical and hydrodynamical principles to analyses of real meteorological data; develops concepts for studying atmospheric circulations, particularly extratropical cyclones and anticyclones. Laboratory work includes the development of diagnostic techniques suitable for a better understanding of the current weather. Prerequisite: ATMS 401 and ATMS 402.
